verdict.rationale: Self-hosting an open-source runtime is a fair question for a voice-agent platform, but the evidence describes Bland only as a hosted platform. Its enterprise offering is dedicated, isolated infrastructure that Bland runs, with versioned releases and canary deployments. Nothing shows open-source code or a way to deploy the runtime on your own infrastructure, and a community user asking for an open-source alternative they can run themselves suggests Bland is not one.
